After surviving a single-target physical hit it counterattacks at once for {MON_COUNTER_MULT:pct} of the damage DEF mitigated (true damage).
Every active damage, heal or shield skill is cast a second time at once, at {MON_ECHO_POWER:pct} power. Its mirror twin takes the first {MON_ECHO_DECOYS} hit(s) aimed at it each fight.
Heals {MON_TIDE_REGEN:pct} of max HP at the start of each of its actions. Healing beyond max HP becomes a shield, up to {MON_TIDE_SHIELD_CAP:pct} of max HP.
Every hit it lands heals it for {MON_DRAIN_FRAC:pct} of the damage dealt. Draining beyond max HP becomes a shield, up to {MON_DRAIN_SHIELD_CAP:pct} of max HP.
Its fire damage is {MON_FIRE_BONUS:pct} stronger, ignores {MON_FIRE_PIERCE:pct} of the target's DEF or WIS and is never resisted by the target's element.
Acts twice in a row on each of its first {MON_DOUBLE_TURNS} turn(s) of a fight.

Max HP in battle is HP x {MON_HP_PER_POINT}. Skills that scale with HP use max HP.

Physical damage. The basic attack hits for {BASIC_ATTACK_POWER} x the higher of STR and INT, and STR-scaled skills deal physical damage. Physical hits can be dodged (DEX) and the target's DEF reduces them.

Magical damage. INT-scaled skills deal magical damage, which can be grazed but not dodged and which the target's WIS reduces. The basic attack uses INT instead of STR when INT is higher, and is then magical.
Magic defence: magical damage taken is multiplied by {MON_DEF_K} / ({MON_DEF_K} + WIS), so {MON_DEF_K} WIS halves it. WIS also sets the amount of WIS-scaled heals and shields.

Dodging and precision. Evade chance is {MON_EVADE_BASE:pct} plus {MON_EVADE_PER_DEX:pct} per point of DEX above the attacker's (minus when below), from 0 to {MON_EVADE_CAP:pct}. A physical hit that rolls under it misses; a magical hit is grazed instead: it deals {MON_GRAZE_MULT:pct} of its damage and cannot crit. DEX also makes the unit's own hits harder to evade, and each point adds {MON_CRIT_DMG_PER_DEX:pct} to its crit damage (a x{MON_CRIT_DMG} crit deals {MON_CRIT_DMG:pct}).
Evades {evade:pct} of {foe}'s hits (spells are grazed); {foe} evades {foe_evade:pct} of the hits it takes; crits deal x{crit_dmg}
Physical defence: physical damage taken is multiplied by {MON_DEF_K} / ({MON_DEF_K} + DEF), so {MON_DEF_K} DEF halves it.

Turn speed. Each tick the action gauge fills by SPD (at least {MON_SPD_MIN}) and the unit acts each time it reaches {BATTLE_GAUGE}. SPD {SPD_REF} acts once per turn; twice the SPD acts twice as often.

Critical hits and fortune. Crit chance is {MON_CRIT_BASE:pct} plus {MON_CRIT_PER_LUK:pct} per LUK (plus crit chance effects), up to {MON_CRIT_CAP:pct}. A crit deals x{MON_CRIT_DMG} damage plus the attacker's DEX bonus (and crit damage effects). Fortune is LUK / (LUK + {MON_FORTUNE_K}), up to {MON_FORTUNE_CAP:pct}: the chance to reroll the unit's own failed evade or failed crit, and to make a crit against it roll again.
